timing: Explicit prospective amendment to the multicavity count-sensitivity experiment. After validation-only results showed learned models already accurate at m=8, the unstarted m=40 block is replaced by the lower-count m=2,4,6 block. Existing m=8,16,24,32 fits remain untouched; the two queued m=32 ICKAN seed-47 fits are completed under their original frozen rule. The same architectures, seeds, objective, optimizer settings and validation stopping criterion apply to every new low-count fit. Test and path labels remain closed.
validation_metric: Mean squared normalized validation stress error divided by the frozen fit-stress denominator; lower is better. The strict minimum over initialization, Adam, and LBFGS selects the final checkpoint.

adam.rule: After at least 2600 Adam steps, stop at a validation check only when the running best validation stress score has failed to improve cumulatively by at least 0.1% over 100 checks and ReduceLROnPlateau has reached the frozen minimum learning rate. Otherwise stop at the 200000-step safety cap. The cap is a resource guard, not a convergence claim.

lbfgs.rule: Start from the best Adam checkpoint. After at least 40 outer calls, stop when the running best validation score has failed to improve cumulatively by at least 0.1% over 30 outer calls. Otherwise stop at the 300-call safety cap.

checkpoint_rule: The final checkpoint is the strict minimum validation score across initialization, Adam, and LBFGS. Report validation-plateau versus safety-cap stop reasons, actual optimizer work, and model hashes for all 60 fits.
evaluation_gate: Do not read reserved test or path prediction targets for the amended count sweep until all retained m=8,16,24,32 fits and all 36 newly declared m=2,4,6 fits are terminal and their reports and hashes are verified.

amendment_scope.decision_basis: Validation-only aggregate results from completed m=8,16,24 fits; no test or path labels were accessed.
amendment_scope.interpretation: The amendment improves resolution at the low-count end; it does not support an unqualified prospective protocol claim for the full seven-count grid.
